display.tagline: Iterative coaching for stronger YC applications.
display.description: An evidence-demanding YC application coach that helps founders write stronger applications through iterative probing, pushback on vague claims, and refinement in the founder's own voice. Refuses to generate answers — forces founders to do the thinking.
capabilities: Coaches founders through all 11 YC application sections one question at a time
Demands specific evidence for every claim — no assertions without proof
Preserves the founder's voice while cutting vague language and startup jargon
Tracks progress across sessions so founders can pick up where they left off
Produces a compiled draft artifact with cross-checked consistency
